ios.desc:
Ever been in a situation where you make a mistake while sending a message to someone? Who hasn't. There are now even apps that let your friends make fun of you for making grammar mistakes. 

Don't you wish you can take your messages back? Erase them from existence?

Well now you can with a sticker pack that is designed to make your messages disappear. Select from a variety of white bubble stickers that can be used to cover any message you want. 

• Cover your typos
• Prank your friends by hiding their messages
• Multiple shapes of white bubbles to fit any type of message 
• We know it's silly to include just white stickers in the pack, so we included a few more for you to enjoy.

White Out is a perfect solution to all your iMessage troubles.
